A brand system for a creative technology studio, built around the existing chameleon mark and custom lettering. Conceptual presentation.

01 — Brand story

Creativity and technology, shaped into clear digital experiences.

Dzynlab brings creativity and technology together to shape digital experiences that are clear, purposeful and adaptable. The studio focuses on UI/UX design and IT-driven solutions.

The chameleon stands for adaptability: a design response that changes with the user, the platform and the problem, while the identity stays unmistakably itself. The spiral tail suggests iteration, from first idea to deployed product.

03 — The chameleon

One symbol, many states.

The silhouette, eye and spiral tail form the recognisable core. Supporting patterns repeat and rotate the real symbol artwork in quarter turns. They stay in tonal greys or a single green accent so they never compete with the master logo.

04 — Colour

Green and black, with room to work.

Green sampled from the supplied logo file. Deep Green and Mint are proposed extensions. CMYK values are naive conversions, so proof against a print profile before production.

05 — Typography

Custom lettering, supported by Space Grotesk and Inter.

Space Grotesk (display, headings, labels, buttons) and Inter (body, UI). Both are open-source Google Fonts. The Dzynlab wordmark is always the original artwork, never typeset.

09 — Guidelines

Using the identity.

Logo

Use supplied artwork only. Keep clear space. Never stretch, recolour, rotate or place on busy imagery.

Colour & type

Green and black lead. Use Deep Green for text on light. Space Grotesk for headings, Inter for body.

Accessibility

Body text needs 4.5:1 contrast. Brand green is for fills, not small text on white.
